# Jumpstyle United Nations

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Mreaggle/JumpstyleUnitedNations
Official public museum: https://jumpstyle.com.br/JUN/
Primary language: English

## Purpose

JUN is a community-maintained historical archive of Jumpstyle dance, music, people, meetings, leagues, forums and national scenes.

## Read before editing

- Agent rules: AGENTS.md
- Contribution workflow: CONTRIBUTING.md
- Evidence policy: docs/EDITORIAL_POLICY.md
- Research coverage and gaps: docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md
- Country-by-country research index: docs/COUNTRY_RESEARCH.md
- Repository architecture: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Structural audit: docs/REPOSITORY_AUDIT.md
- Country status data: data/country-research.json
- Global-to-national assignments: data/global-event-countries.json
- Public source registry: data/source-registry.json

## Primary historical datasets

- Global Timeline: JumpstyleTimeline/Global/global-timeline.md
- National Timelines: JumpstyleTimeline/
- Key Figures Worldwide: JUNToolkit/KeyFiguresWorldwide/Dance/README.md
- Volunteers: Volunteers.md

## Critical caveats

- Nineteen national timeline files still contain legacy placeholder scaffolds. Placeholders are not evidence.
- Generated national blocks come from data/global-event-countries.json. Update the manifest and run npm run sync:national; do not edit those blocks manually.
- The Global Timeline is add-only by default. Do not delete entries while enriching it.
- Private chats and contact exports must never be committed, quoted or used as public citations.
- Store event date, upload date and archive date separately. If only upload date survives, label it as a fallback.
- Key Figures Worldwide is a community-curated influence index, not a definitive ranking.

## Validation

Run synchronization: npm run sync:national

Run validation: npm run check
